body: Can you bisect the failure? (And make sure to `git clean -fdx` to make absolutely sure you don't have stale build files; if you use `ccache` or `sccache`, wipe those too.)

Relevant commit is in fact https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/ae9674704ac5586438f60c883e918d448ef0e237
So please check your environment variables. Are you calling make in a naked terminal, or within tmux or Neovim terminal or similar?

That's the error, not the path. In https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/30237 I didn't bother printing the path but probably should: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/30285
I encounter this on my system as well. Didn't bother debugging further yet but removing `/tmp/nvimsocket` from my fs resolves the error (for a while).

> I encounter this on my system as well. Didn't bother debugging further yet but removing `/tmp/nvimsocket` from my fs resolves the error (for a while).

If something is setting `$NVIM_LISTEN_ADDRESS` or `--listen` to a fixed path (`/tmp/nvimsocket`), only the first Nvim can listen on that path. Nvim is reporting an error correctly in that case.
I see. Don't remember why that's in my env in the first place.
